mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_recharge_order (order_no, user_id, amount_fen, points, channel, status, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{amountFen}, #{points}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, order_no, user_id, amount_fen, points, channel, status, pay_time, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_recharge_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_recharge_order SET status = 'PAID', pay_time = #{payTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING'
